facts.business: Family Care Hospitals Limited operates a multi-specialty hospital facility and is pivoting towards digital healthcare delivery models including mobile applications and online platforms following the suspension of physical clinical operations.

auditor.name: M/s Rafik & Associates, Chartered Accountants
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matters: (a) Company holds Discount Coupon Vouchers amounting to Rs. 38.03 crores in inventory unsold/unutilized due to temporary closure of main hospital. (b) No interest payment made to MSME Vendors; unable to comment on interest provision due to lack of bifurcation of amounts due >45 days. (c) Company experienced ransomware attack on January 30, 2026, corrupting primary and backup electronic data; financial information reconstructed using secondary sources. (d) Prior year financial statements audited by predecessor auditor S.M. Gupta & Co. who expressed unmodified opinion.

key_risks: Suspension of physical multi-specialty clinical operations at flagship hospital facility
Ongoing property, lease, and regulatory compliance hurdles including execution orders from historical Mahim lease dispute
Ransomware attack on January 30, 2026 leading to corruption of primary and backup electronic data
Unsold/unutilized Discount Coupon Vouchers inventory of Rs. 38.03 crores due to hospital closure
Non-payment of interest to MSME vendors with potential liability
Net loss after tax of Rs. 868.28 lakhs for FY 2025-26
facts.related_party_note: Refer to Note No. 30 'Disclosure of Related Parties Transactions' of Notes to the Financial Statements for the year ended March 31, 2026.
